hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to total pieces is $\purpleE2:4$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ total pieces.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | $\purpleD{2}$ | $\stackrel{\times 25}\rightarrow$ | $\purpleD{50}$
Parts per whole | $4$ | $\stackrel{\times 25}\rightarrow$  | $100$
$\purpleE{50}\%$ is represented by the shaded area.
